_protocol.start: public u015 theta of the main ODE member
_protocol.P1: cauchy + importance weights p_test/p_train over (age since control change x at-recovery) bins, ratio clipped [0.1,10], mean 1
_protocol.P2: L-BFGS-B, mean smooth (1-score) (eps 0.05) + lam*mean (z-z_P0)^2, 25 evals from P0; lam in {0.1,1,10,100,1000} by held-out score on the other folds (their fits include the scored run as training data)
_protocol.P3: mean/median/balanced-tree of P0 fits with one more run left out plus the fold P0; P3m2/P3m3: medoid members only; P3par: z-space parameter mean
_protocol.P4: y0 shrunk toward reset mean by noise^2/(noise^2+spread^2)
_protocol.win_rule: gain>0.01 vs P0, pulse folds mean delta >= -0.002, exam (p5.testlike fold / p6.exam) delta >= -0.002; P3mean excluded (runtime has no mean)
